caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal object resembling a shallow plate or tray, rendered in shades of reddish-brown. The plate has a broad rim with a subtle, braided or twisted border pattern around the edge. The central section of the plate features embossed or incised decorations, including a stylized central flower with two side clusters of smaller circular shapes, possibly representing additional flowers or fruit. There are two five-pointed stars positioned symmetrically to the left and right of the flower. Below the central motif is a rectangular cartouche with the date "1717" and a set of indistinct letters or numbers inside it. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and the signature "FRANCES LILCITEN" appears to the lower right of the plate. The color palette primarily includes various browns with lighter highlights and darker shadows for three-dimensional effect.
title: Pa. German Octagonal Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
